title: B2B E-Invoicing: How It Works, Mandates, and Compliance
summary: B2B e-invoicing replaces PDFs with structured invoice data. Learn how it works, which countries mandate it and when, and how to get compliant.

**Italy**


Businesses established in Italy


Issue and receive


Live since 1 January 2019


Clearance through SdI


[Belgium](https://www.getsphere.com/blog/e-invoicing-in-belgium)


VAT-registered businesses established in Belgium


Issue and receive


Live since 1 January 2026. The three-month penalty grace period has ended.


Post-audit. Peppol BIS is the default.


**Croatia**


VAT-registered businesses. Non-VAT taxpayers receive only for now.


Issue and receive


Live since 1 January 2026. Non-VAT taxpayers start issuing in 2027.


Fiscalization 2.0, with a buyer right to reject


[Poland](https://www.getsphere.com/blog/e-invoicing-in-poland)


Businesses established in Poland


Issue and receive


Live since 1 February 2026 for large businesses (turnover above PLN 200 million). Live since 1 April 2026 for most others.


Clearance through KSeF


**Germany**


Businesses established in Germany


Receive now, issue later


Receiving live since 1 January 2025. Issuing starts 1 January 2027 for turnover above €800,000, and 1 January 2028 for all.


Post-audit. EN 16931 formats such as XRechnung and ZUGFeRD.


[France](https://www.getsphere.com/blog/e-invoicing-in-france)


VAT-subject companies established in France


Receive for all, issue by size


Receiving live for all since 1 September 2026. Large and mid-sized companies issue since 1 September 2026. SMEs and micro-businesses issue from 1 September 2027.


Government-approved platforms. Formats include Factur-X.


[Spain](https://www.getsphere.com/blog/verifactu-spain)


Businesses and professionals established in Spain


Issue and receive


Upcoming. 6 October 2027 for turnover above €8 million. 6 October 2028 for all others.


Private platforms plus a public solution run by the tax agency
